lead: Shahid Afridi is best known as a Pakistani cricketer, born on 1 March 1980 in Khyber District.
As of 2026, he is 46 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has represented Northern Cape cricket team and Melbourne Renegades and has held the office of chairperson.
The sections that follow break down Shahid Afridi's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: Shahid Afridi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shahid Afridi was born on 1 March 1980 in Khyber District, and holds Pakistani nationality. He was given the name Sahibzada Mohammad Shahid Khan Afridi at birth and is publicly known as Shahid Afridi.

sections.heading: Shahid Afridi — Career and Professional Work
paras: Shahid Afridi works primarily as a cricketer.

On the team sheet, Shahid has been associated with Northern Cape cricket team (from 2003 to 2004), Melbourne Renegades (from 2011), Pakistan national cricket team (from 1998 to 2010), list of First Class Karachi cricket teams (from 1995 to 2017), Habib Bank Limited cricket team (from 1997 to 2017), Leicestershire County Cricket Club (from 2001 to 2001), Derbyshire County Cricket Club (from 2003 to 2003) and Kent County Cricket Club (from 2004 to 2004). He plays as a batter.
He has held the following offices: chairperson (2014–present).
